reason: Provider independence of local records is assumed; substitute availability and compatibility are not given.
Alias is not immutable model identity; a feedback loop requires reuse of error, not the weight change alone.
Following text is stipulated, but privileged execution, disclosure and persistence depend on actual capabilities and destinations.
Reviewer count supplies no independence; persistent regime requires circular reuse or suppression of contradictory outcomes.
Source supports acceptance of unverified path strings in this function, not a deployed hallucination or persistent false-belief loop.
OS eviction behavior, memory limits and restart ordering determine duration; committed storage survival is not guaranteed by RAM pressure alone.
No per-call identity evidence is available. ADR 0020 explicitly leaves attribution across switches open.
An ideal endless sequence is distinct from any finite observed trace; a growing useful partial result may be economically rational.
Compiler reports bytes but sets no model-window bound; actual rejection or truncation behavior belongs to the uninspected harness.
An executable oracle removes model grading, not test leakage or a wrong oracle. Fixture-specific optimization may be harmless if the claim is fixture-specific.
Source-supported timing boundary only; actual queue-to-start integration and required policy revision remain unspecified.
Explicit source error is implemented; propagation to a deployed scheduler and recovery duration were not observed.
Compiler includes supplied task text without a secret classifier; durable intake path and recipient authorization determine actual exposure.
Non-traversal is source-supported. Any crawler branch is a separate explicitly hypothetical executor.
The sources may differ in jurisdiction or effective time rather than one simply being false.
Mutable address and immutable content identity are different. The scenario does not prove anyone relies on the changed page.
Native configuration semantics and harness trust settings are not inspected, so execution is a conditional branch.
Actual shared-memory authorization is not established by scope naming; a genuine write is not necessarily disclosure unless readers differ.
Artifact store normalization, filesystem behavior and collision policy are missing; path identity of scope directories would not settle artifact identity.
ADR 0020 forbids production full transcripts but is a design rule, not proof of redaction or safe telemetry.
Same user is not a complete sandbox; keychain ACL, unlock status and recipient authorization still matter to the exact exposure.
Manifest validation is promised; binding the bytes checked to bytes executed is not established in inspected source.
Design assigns peer authentication to transport; domain validation does not independently prove which human spoke.
Inspected schema is mutable rather than a tamper-proof event log; local connection access is not an OS isolation boundary.
Existing backup code escapes SQL quotes, but it is not the unnamed new plugin parameter. No general injection outcome can be inferred.
Rendering and subsequent operator reliance, not merely storage of escapes, cause the diagnostic failure.
Token format, epochs, clock and revocation location are unspecified; a restore-local check cannot know a missing later revocation.
Name similarity alone is not execution; install scripts, selection and executable trust determine entry.
Encryption is not logically permanent loss merely because no key is currently known; paying or contacting attacker is not authorized or assumed.
rule::check prevents revisiting a chain scope, not aggregate fan-out. Fixed finite scopes bound chain depth but not the number of task instances.
Append-only event history is a target design, not the inspected mutable implementation. Neither unconditional deletion nor unconditional retention is inferred as law.
Race ordering, service of the order and precise data scope decide the branch. Inspected backup library does not implement automatic retention.
Processing location, contractual exceptions and what data was transmitted are required; all cloud use is not assumed unlawful.
Credential validity and information sensitivity differ; rotation need not erase personal data or prevent decryption with a retained key.
The new license is not presumed to revoke rights already granted for older releases; redistribution and dependency necessity need legal review.
Design promises authenticated actors, not proof that a shared credential maps uniquely to one physical person or proves intent.
Legal authority, access terms, encryption and existence of independent lawful copies determine availability and exposure; no evasion is assumed.
Need classification effective date, recipient inventory and retention purpose; current restrictions do not imply identical historic law.
Deleting a registry entry is not necessarily deleting provenance. Actual schema and retained content determine what can be answered.
SQLite integrity and snapshot existence do not demonstrate content, keys, tools, authority or external-effect reconciliation. No drill was executed in this review.
The multiplier alone does not imply insolvency; volume, preexisting commitments and enforceable caps determine loss.
Must know contract effective time, provider-side cap and pending usage to bound actual liability.
Max sessions per agent is not a demonstrated cross-scope fairness rule. Feedback requires endogenous allocation advantage.
Human attention and opportunity cost count as service cost; batching authority is not presumed valid for every effect.
Baseline utilization, task service times, arrival duration and retry behavior are unspecified; tenfold does not itself prove overload.
Recorded cancellation is not forcible termination and cannot recall accepted external calls. Budget enforcement was not established in inspected code.
Need worst-case computation, external inference latency and whether outage intervals count; local presence alone gives no hard bound.
Loss concerns the original business objective, not necessarily the truth or reusability of late output.
Provider deletion timing, retained exports and alternative custody determine recovery diversity; no cancellation was performed.
Token counts are not universal prices and objective outcome comparison may remain valid while monetary comparison fails.
Concrete changed behavior and test oracle are unspecified; unchanged code does not imply unchanged executable environment.
An upcaster is necessary only when required historical payloads are incompatible; additive backward-compatible events may need none.
SQL transactions serialize bytes within one database, not incompatible semantic interpretations or effects outside it.
Forward-only migration list does not prove historical binary behavior. The old release and data shapes must be tested offline.
Download availability, installed runtime, source buildability and legal redistribution rights are separate variables.
README documents the subtree boundary but a documented command is not proof of every publisher invoking it correctly. No publication occurred here.
The scenario stipulates a wrong oracle; no particular current missing-ID implementation is accused without inspection.
Static README/source mismatch was observed. Operational impact and stable belief dynamics remain conditional.
This violates the design ordering but is not an observed updater implementation in the inspected libraries.
Service count alone is not coupling or a demonstrated feedback loop; ownership and removal decisions determine persistence.
Ability to authenticate is distinct from legal or organizational authority; succession provisions are unspecified.
Legitimate titles do not settle quorum, delegation, timing or scope; last instruction arrival is not automatically valid precedence.
Rights changing on paper and revocation reaching every session or restore are different events; historic authorship should not be relabeled.
Compiler concatenation establishes what it reads, not the legal transferability of those bytes. Not all company instructions are necessarily needed.
Both authority over risk and knowledge of prior effects are necessary; either can remain absent after the other is resolved.
Agent replacement does not necessarily break output contracts; incomparable observation fields are not zero-valued measurements.
Need actual ability to bypass and reward asymmetry. Legitimately eliminating unnecessary blocks is a competing beneficial interpretation.
Privacy or contractual confidentiality may justify nondisclosure; neither resource use nor fair entitlement can be inferred from budget secrecy alone.
Design append-only promises and mutable local implementation differ. A correction appended with provenance is not equivalent to concealed rewriting.
Partner absence removes one witness, not necessarily all evidence; timeouts do not establish failure.
Per-scope explicit activation bounds dependencies semantically, not aggregate resource use. Actual process footprint and sharing are missing.
Same UID is a trust-boundary warning, not proof of a particular leak. OS sandbox and key access restrictions could provide additional boundaries.
Need what work may execute offline, who controls hardware, and whether credentials or sensitive data can be inspected by that owner.
Missing offline functionality, OS suspension rules, permissible remote daemon, latency and background-effect requirements.
Missing partition behavior, permissible unavailability, global effect ownership, quorum placement, latency bounds and authority to fail over.
No control-loop period, plant state, safety interlock or worst-case delay is supplied. Approval before motion is not a real-time safety proof.
Root can control local files and code under the stated model; whether an independent trust anchor exists is unspecified.
Event replay is target design. Snapshot existence alone does not show bounded validation, tail processing or content retrieval time.
Completeness includes interpretation, scope lineage and required artifacts, not just a SQL dump; export and legal deletion are separate requests.
A graph cycle alone is insufficient for deadlock; readiness semantics and independent bootstrap determine entry.
Need geography, media exposure, keys and replacement tool availability. Correlation weakens the inference from copy count to independence.
Clock correctness, missed-occurrence policy and surviving legal entity are unknown; normal chronological processing need not be meaningful after decades.
Natural-language fluency is not proof of original business meaning; missing tacit context may be unrecoverable even with intact encodings.
Universal reviewer agreement is stipulated, not universal failure of all experiments. No meta-reviewer outside the premise is invented.
Missing meaning of legitimate, common object identity, effective time, jurisdiction and whether clones must converge at all.
Missing jurisdiction, precise data and proof definitions, exception rules and authoritative precedence; literal mutually exclusive obligations have no joint technical solution.
Energy availability does not specify energy quantity, startup time, durable checkpoints or useful task granularity.
Practical breaks undermine capability claims but do not themselves prove an attacker used them; independent physical provenance may survive.
Legal succession and credential possession are separate. No arrival-order or majority rule is presumed to settle ownership.
Total loss is conditional on the stated complete information boundary, including no external reconstructive trace. This is logical loss, not an empirical attractor.
Source directly supports snapshot-local queued/no-attempt behavior; actual later dispatch and duplicate external effects remain conditional.
Need write-failure handling, acknowledgement semantics, current in-flight effects and whether stopping needs disk. Flood plus timing alone does not prove the revocation was lost.
Restoring runtime alone does not resolve authority or budget. Releasing leases without evidence could enable conflicts rather than recovery.
Need whether content is actually required by reducers and whether the order allows a lawful retained representation. No unauthorized preservation is assumed.
Syntactic acceptance, semantic correctness and independent verification are separate. A format change alone need not produce wrong business meaning.
Cron catch-up policy is not inspected or assumed implemented. Two-agent same-chain ping-pong is a counterexample excluded by current delegation gate, not proof of bounded total task count.
Forward object version, human edit, retained compensation schema and actual executed plugin identity must all be known; design promises are not verified runtime behavior.
Database transaction atomicity does not fence an independent host or participant. Need writer ownership and participant identities across cutover.
Vendor insolvency alone does not make open or retained software unusable. Lost indispensable encryption key differs from merely unavailable downloads.
Feedback requires report authority to actually govern testing, as stipulated. This reviews own complete coverage is a disposition ledger, never empirical success evidence.
